thread:
ada: Quick heads-up 1 — ACME asked for a Dedicated pilot commitment: 60k qps burst in us-west-2 for 5-10m windows. They want latency target ~120ms p95 for short prompts. Need to decide what we can promise and the cadence for commits. Anyone free for a quick triage?
noah (eng-runtime): I can take this. Clarify: 60k burst is peak concurrent qps or sustained for the window?
ada (product PM): peak qps during onboarding spikes. baseline expected ~8-12k.
tia (eng-infra): 60k peak in-region is heavy but not impossible. Still need model memory footprint, sequence length distribution, and whether ACME allows quantized variants.
ada: They prefer same model family but are okay with 8-bit if quality delta is small.
noah (eng-runtime): Ok. Propose a 3-tier commitment we can present: Gold/Silver/Bronze. Quick sketch:
- Gold: guarantee up to 60k peak with prewarm pool + reserved GPUs, strict SLA (<120ms p95), higher monthly fee.
- Silver: reserve for 30k peak, fast autoscale to 60k best-effort with documented fallback to quantized variant. SLA relaxed to <200ms p95.
- Bronze: best-effort, no burst guarantee, telemetry + "x-fallback-model" header when degraded.
tia (eng-infra): Love the tiers. For Gold we need reserved burst pool (estimate: 12 x A100-ish equivalents in region), network tuning, and autoscaler prewarm hooks. Cost estimate depends on reserved hours.
omar (sre): Runbook items: warm pool health checks, graceful degradation path, load-shedding thresholds, and customer-facing error pages if capacity hits. Also add canary rollout for autoscaler changes.
hana (security): Note on KMS/HSM: ACME requires customer-managed keys; node boot may need KMS handshake which can add ~30-90s cold-start. That makes prewarm more critical. Need IAM and audit policy review.
noah (eng-runtime): Runtime work: prefix/KV caching per-tenant, adaptive batching with latency boundary, and an automatic fallback router that switches to quantized model when p95 > threshold. I can prototype fallback + header telemetry.
ada: Product acceptance criteria if Gold: 1) demonstrable <120ms p95 in staging under 60k simulated bursts 2) telemetry for fallback rates and model variant used 3) documented cost delta for ACME.
tia (eng-infra): Early infra checklist: region capacity check, reserve burst pool, add prewarm lifecycle hook to autoscaler, network egress checks. I'll run a cost sim matrix for Bronze/Silver/Gold by EOD tomorrow.
omar (sre): I'll draft the runbook and test plan for warm pool eviction and failover paths. Want a staged loadtest: dev -> staging -> canary.
hana (security): I'll scope KMS onboarding time and the IAM changes; expect ~4 business days for full certs + test.
deploy-bot: FYI: deploy freeze Thu 17:00 - Fri 09:00 UTC. Any infra or autoscaler changes may need a staging-only hotfix window.
ada: Proposed decision cadence: set a hard checkpoint in 72h. If Gold chosen, infra + security commit timelines must align; else Silver as fallback.
noah (eng-runtime): Action items: prototype fallback router in dev (48h), perf microbench of quant variant (24-36h).
tia (eng-infra): Action items: cost sim matrix (EOD tomorrow), region capacity confirmation (48h), mock autoscaler prewarm smoke test (48h).
omar (sre): Action items: runbook draft and initial loadtest plan (48h).
hana (security): Action items: KMS onboarding checklist and blocker list (48h).
ada: Thanks all. Please flag if you hit blockers or need decisions earlier. I'll send summary and the 72h checkpoint calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
